pr_comments: I've added some unit tests which cover exclusive function systems, and function systems. They ensure that the `TypeId` value is consistent between `System` and `IntoSystem` implementations, and also consistent with `TypeId::of::<T::System>()` where `T` is the `IntoSystem` type. I've also updated the description of this PR to explicitly call out exactly what cases will require some kind of migration work.

issue_context.title: Stored `TypeId` of systems have an unexpected value
issue_context.body:
Ideally we don't need to actually construct the system to get the TypeId here. We should be able to rely on `TypeId::of::<IntoSys::System>()`. However currently that is out of sync with `FunctionSystem`'s `type_id()` implementation. I'll add a `PERF` todo.

_Originally posted by @cart in https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/8453#discussion_r1476923360_

review_comments: The removal of these methods is breaking. Still good to do, but should be in a migration guide.
These methods are still available with the same API (they're provided by `System`), they just produce a different value. I'll still add an explicit migration guide.
